rulebook.title: The Monarchist
rulebook.pitch: A Fascist who wants the board, not Hitler. Splits the Fascist team and can seize the presidency at Special Election.

details.label: Goal
text: You are far right, but you play for your own goal. You win when the Fascist board is full or when Hitler is executed. You lose if Hitler is elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy: the Fascists win then, but you do not.

details.label: What you know
text: Nobody. At setup you keep your eyes closed and show a thumb, so the Fascists (not Hitler) know who you are. You do not learn who the Fascists or Hitler are.

details.label: Power
text: There is only ever one President. When the President names a pick at Call Special Election, you may reveal and become the next President instead.

You and the outgoing President each name a Chancellor candidate. Everyone hands a ballot card to their choice, and you break ties. The President placard then returns to the left of the President who called the Special Election.

details.label: Danger
text: You want Fascist policies but not Hitler in power, yet the Fascists will not tell you who he is. Any Chancellor elected after the 3rd Fascist policy could cost you the game.

details.label: How to play it
text: Push Fascist policies, block any Chancellor you suspect of being Hitler and steer executions towards him.
